body.brief: Design Maddie v3. TWO HARD CONSTRAINTS RAISED BY OPERATOR (must be addressed in artifact form for resolution): (1) inheritance-semantics-001 — full post-subject-death access policy: who gets which stories, what triggers it (death certificate? designated family-trustee verification?), what legal frame (Canada/NB inheritance law touchpoints), what happens to stories the subject explicitly marked private-only, what audit trail proves the trigger fired correctly. Default policy must be SEALED, not open. (2) auth-friction-001 — onboarding has zero technical-credential entry visible to subject. Magic-link via SMS or email is the only surface; SUBJECT_TOKEN is bound at server-side after link click, never typed. Subject sees: tap your name on family invite → recording starts. Specify these two policies AS ARTIFACTS sharp enough to resolve their respective constraints. Include the api endpoints + UI states + state-transition diagram for each. 800 words max combined.
body.output_text:
# Maddie v3 API Specification

## ARTIFACT 1: Post-Subject-Death Access Policy (inheritance-semantics-001)

### Policy: SEALED-BY-DEFAULT

**Trigger Chain (all must fire sequentially):**

```
ALIVE → DEATH_CLAIM_FILED → DEATH_VERIFIED → ESTATE_UNLOCKED → STORIES_DISTRIBUTED
```

**State Transition Diagram:**

```
┌─────────┐  family_trustee POST /estate/claim  ┌──────────────────┐
│  ALIVE   │ ──────────────────────────────────→ │ DEATH_CLAIM_FILED│
└─────────┘                                      └────────┬─────────┘
                                                          │ admin verifies
                                                          │ death certificate
                                                          ▼
                                              ┌──────────────────────┐
                                              │   DEATH_VERIFIED     │
                                              └────────┬─────────────┘
                                                       │ 30-day hold period
                                                       ▼
                                              ┌──────────────────────┐
                                              │   ESTATE_UNLOCKED    │
                                              └────────┬─────────────┘
                                                       │ per-story ACL applied
                                                       ▼
                                              ┌──────────────────────┐
                                              │ STORIES_DISTRIBUTED  │
                                              └──────────────────────┘
```

**Story Classification & Inheritance Rules:**

| Story Mark | While Alive | After Death (default) | Override |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FAMILY_SHARED` | visible to family circle | released to designated heirs | none needed |
| `PRIVATE_ONLY` | subject-only | **PERMANENTLY SEALED** — deleted after 90 days | subject pre-mortem can flip to `FAMILY_SHARED` |
| `TRUSTEE_HOLD` | subject + trustee | trustee decides release | trustee must act within 1 year or sealed |

**Legal Frame (Canada/NB):** Aligns with NB *Devolution of Estates Act* — digital assets treated as personal property. Designated `FAMILY_TRUSTEE` role maps to estate executor. Platform terms require subject to consent to inheritance policy at onboarding. Stories marked `PRIVATE_ONLY` are **not estate property** — treated as destroyed correspondence.

**Audit Trail:** Every state transition writes to `estate_audit_log` (immutable append-only). Fields: `timestamp`, `actor_id`, `action`, `evidence_hash` (SHA-256 of uploaded death certificate), `witness_attestation_id`.

### Endpoints

```
POST   /v3/estate/claim                 scope: FAMILY_TRUSTEE
  body: { subject_id, certificate_upload_url, relationship_proof }
  returns: { claim_id, status: "DEATH_CLAIM_FILED" }

POST   /v3/estate/{claim_id}/verify     scope: PLATFORM_ADMIN
  body: { certificate_verified: bool, notes }
  returns: { status: "DEATH_VERIFIED", hold_expires_at }

GET    /v3/estate/{claim_id}/status      scope: FAMILY_TRUSTEE, FAMILY_MEMBER
  returns: { status, hold_expires_at, stories_available_count }

GET    /v3/estate/{claim_id}/stories     scope: FAMILY_TRUSTEE
  returns: [{ story_id, mark, heir_visible: bool }]
  note: only returns non-PRIVATE_ONLY after ESTATE_UNLOCKED

GET    /v3/estate/audit/{subject_id}     scope: PLATFORM_ADMIN, FAMILY_TRUSTEE
  returns: [{ timestamp, actor_id, action, evidence_hash }]
```

---

## ARTIFACT 2: Zero-Friction Auth (auth-friction-001)

### Policy: NO VISIBLE CREDENTIALS

**Flow:**

```
┌────────────┐  family creates invite   ┌──────────────┐
│ UNINVITED  │ ───────────────────────→  │ INVITE_SENT  │
└────────────┘                           └──────┬───────┘
                                                │ subject taps name
                                                │ in SMS/email link
                                                ▼
                                        ┌───────────────┐
                                        │ LINK_CLICKED   │
                                        │ (server binds  │
                                        │ SUBJECT_TOKEN) │
                                        └──────┬────────┘
                                               │ auto-redirect
                                               ▼
                                        ┌───────────────┐
                                        │ RECORDING_READY│
                                        └───────────────┘
```

**UI States:**

| State | Subject Sees | Technical Reality |
|---|---|---|
| `INVITE_SENT` | SMS: "Hi Grandma, tap here to tell your story →" | Magic link contains `{invite_token}` |
| `LINK_CLICKED` | "Welcome, [Name]! 🎙️" + large Record button | Server exchanges `invite_token` → `SUBJECT_TOKEN` via `Set-Cookie: httpOnly, secure, sameSite=strict` |
| `RECORDING_READY` | Prompt card + record button. Zero forms. | Token silently attached to all subsequent requests |
| `SESSION_EXPIRED` | "Tap to continue →" (re-sends magic link) | New magic link, same flow |

**Hard rule:** No password, no email input, no username field ever rendered to subject. `SUBJECT_TOKEN` is a server-side opaque session bound to device fingerprint + invite lineage.
